candidates.source_description:
This 1980s offshore catamaran packed 1,400 horsepower! The 38-foot Sea Hawk, designed by Clive Curtis, used twin 700-hp K&S&W engines and was built to stay controllable in brutal rough water. It became an icon of offshore racing’s golden era, with these lightweight cats capable of speeds around 140+ mph.
